items.title: Obtain a Rockland County home improvement contractor license
items.authority: Rockland County Office of Consumer Protection
items.description: Anyone doing home improvement work on residential property in Rockland County needs a county license. The application (experience-based, out-of-jurisdiction for those licensed elsewhere for five years without complaints, or surety bond) needs proof of insurance and of experience for each classification, plus a fee that the county's pages do not list. Since April 2025 renewals are online only, with an email reminder.

appliesWhen.description: Does home improvement work on residential property

items.title: Register for and pay the Saratoga County occupancy tax
items.description: The County Treasurer collects and regulates the county occupancy tax and runs a registration and tax portal for short-term rental owners and operators. The rate was 1% under state law as of early 2025, and a county resolution of January 2026 refers to a local law setting up a short-term rental registry and applying the tax to short-term rental units; the current rate and the return dates were not confirmed.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Schenectady County occupancy tax
items.description: Owners of all hotels, motels and short-term rentals complete the registration form, and the Finance Department then issues a Certificate of Authority to collect the 5% occupancy tax under Local Law 4 of 1985.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Schenectady County occupancy tax return
items.description: The county page, written for short-term rentals, has payments due on the 20th of the month after each month, payable online or by mail. It does not say whether hotels and motels follow the same monthly schedule, so confirm with the Finance Department.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Schoharie County occupancy tax return
items.description: Operators file a quarterly occupancy tax return and remit 4% of net taxable lodging income by the 20th of March, June, September and December, even when nothing is owed. A return postmarked after the due date carries a $50 penalty, and the form allows a collection credit of 5% of the tax, up to $200. The county's registration steps were not found on the pages read.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: New York Tax Law section 1202-i lets Schuyler County tax hotel and motel rooms, but no county law, rate, registration or return pages were found. Other county-level business duties were not checked.

items.title: Register for the Seneca County occupancy tax
items.description: Every operator of a facility providing overnight lodging, including bed and breakfasts, cabins and vacation rentals, registers with the County Treasurer for a Certificate of Authority and starts collecting the tax. An operator who stops renting files a notice of termination of operations.
items.deadline: Within three days of starting operations

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Seneca County occupancy tax return
items.description: A return is required every quarter whether or not tax is due: December to February is due March 20, March to May June 20, June to August September 20 and September to November December 20. Operators who use a management service remain responsible. The rate was 3% in the 2016 local law; the current local law is 3 of 2022, so confirm it.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: New York Tax Law section 1202-ll lets St. Lawrence County tax hotel and motel rooms (cap raised to 5% in 2026), and the Board of Legislators took up a new Room Occupancy Tax Local Law in May 2026, but the adopted rate, registration and return dates were not found. Other county-level business duties were not checked.

items.title: Register for the Steuben County occupancy tax
items.description: Hotels, motels, inns and bed and breakfasts register with the Finance Office on a paper application for a Certificate of Authority; short-term rentals booked through platforms such as Airbnb or Vrbo can apply on paper or through the county's online system.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Steuben County occupancy tax return
items.description: A return is required every quarter, even when no tax is owed, and the county tax is 4% of room income. The hotel and motel return lists due dates of March 20, June 20, September 20 and December 20; the platform short-term rental form uses calendar quarters due April 20, July 20, October 20 and January 20, so confirm which form applies. A late return adds a 5% penalty plus 1% a month in interest.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Suffolk County occupancy tax
items.authority: Suffolk County Comptroller, Hotel and Motel Tax
items.description: Every facility that rents lodging for under 30 days in Suffolk County must register with the county, including residences and tourist homes, not only hotels and motels. Operating unregistered carries a fine of $50 a day per facility.
items.deadline: Within ten days of the first rental

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Suffolk County occupancy tax return
items.authority: Suffolk County Comptroller, Hotel and Motel Tax
items.description: Registered facilities file through the county's portal and remit the 5.5% occupancy tax (rate effective June 1, 2023) on the per diem room rate every quarter. A late filing adds a 10% penalty plus 1% monthly interest starting 30 days after the deadline.
exemptions: Permanent residents (stays of 30 or more consecutive days)

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation Mobility Tax (MCTMT) return
items.authority: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance
items.description: Employers that must withhold New York income tax and have more than $312,500 of payroll expense in a quarter within the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District (the five New York City counties and Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk and Westchester) file Form MTA-305 each quarter. Suffolk County is in Zone 2, where the tax is 0.055% on payroll up to $375,000, 0.115% up to $437,500, 0.34% up to $2.5 million and 0.635% above. The employer pays it and may not deduct it from wages. There are no extensions.
exemptions: Employers whose payroll expense in the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District is $312,500 or less in the quarter
Federal agencies, the United Nations and similar exempt employers
Local government employers (not subject to the tax in Zone 2)

appliesWhen.description: Payroll above $312,500 in a quarter (about $1.25 million a year)

items.title: Obtain a Suffolk County home improvement license
items.authority: Suffolk County Department of Consumer Affairs
items.description: Home improvement contractors need a county license. Applicants pass a written exam on Suffolk Code chapter 563 and New York General Business Law, and the code sets a $200 application fee and a $200 per year license fee with a two-year term (confirm the amount owed with the office). A renewal must be applied for and paid before expiry or the license becomes void, and pool and spa contractors need six hours of continuing education to renew.

appliesWhen.description: Does home improvement work on residential property

items.title: Register for the Sullivan County occupancy tax
items.authority: Sullivan County Treasurer, Room Tax Division
items.description: Any facility rented for 90 consecutive days or less to an occupant who does not own it applies to the County Treasurer for a Certificate of Authority. Registration is renewed every two years (the current period runs to December 31, 2026).

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Sullivan County occupancy tax return
items.authority: Sullivan County Treasurer, Room Tax Division
items.description: Operators file a room tax return every quarter, whether or not tax is owed, and remit the 5% tax; returns for periods ending in February, May, August and November are due within 20 days (the 20th of March, June, September and December). Annual filers file within 20 days after August 31.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: New York Tax Law section 1202-aa*7 lets Tioga County tax hotel and motel rooms, and a 2017 county resolution sets it at 4% of the per diem rate, but the county's registration and return pages were not found. Other county-level business duties were not checked.

items.title: Register for the Tompkins County occupancy tax
items.description: Lodging properties register with the Finance Department using the county's online form (or a paper copy by request) to obtain a Certificate of Authority. Short-term rental units pay a $125 registration fee per unit; hotels and motels pay none. Establishments with an existing certificate were asked to re-register.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Tompkins County occupancy tax return
items.description: Returns and payments are quarterly for periods ending in February, May, August and November, due on the 20th of March, June, September and December. The county's room occupancy tax law sets the rate at 4% of the rent (rate taken from a 2019 copy of the law).
exemptions: Permanent residents (stays of more than 30 days)
Certain religious, charitable or educational stays and New York or United States government stays

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: No county general business license or business personal property return was found; the county's business filing is the occupancy tax for lodging operators.

items.title: Register for the Ulster County occupancy tax
items.description: Hotel, motel and short-term rental operators must obtain a Certificate of Authority from the county at no cost and display it at the property. It applies to operators of lodging only.
items.deadline: No later than three days after commencing business

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Ulster County occupancy tax return
items.description: Lodging operators file a quarterly occupancy tax return and remit the 4% tax collected from occupants, even when nothing is owed. Booking services such as Airbnb and VRBO remit for the bookings they facilitate.
exemptions: Permanent residents occupying a room for at least 90 consecutive days

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Warren County occupancy tax
items.description: Hotels, motels and short-term rentals (any dwelling unit rented for under 30 consecutive days) register by sending the county's registration form to the Warren County Treasurer in Lake George, choosing a monthly, quarterly or annual filing cycle.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Warren County occupancy tax return
items.description: Operators file for their chosen cycle and remit the county tax of 4% of net rental income. Postmarks do not count, the payment must arrive by the due date; a late payment adds a 5% penalty and interest of 1% a month. The guest is liable for the tax and the operator collects it.
items.deadline: 20th of the month after the reporting period ends

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Washington County occupancy tax
items.description: Operators apply on the county's Certificate of Registration form (Application for Certificate of Authority to Collect Hotel Occupancy Tax) to the Treasurer's Office in Fort Edward.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Washington County occupancy tax return
items.description: The return covers December to February, March to May, June to August and September to November, due March 20, June 20, September 20 and December 20, and is required whether or not tax is owed. A copy of the establishment's matching New York sales tax return goes with it. A late payment adds a 5% penalty and 1% a month interest after the first 30 days.
exemptions: Stays of 30 consecutive days or more (permanent guests)
Occupancy by New York State and public corporations

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: New York Tax Law section 1202-ii (2023) lets Wayne County tax hotel, motel and seasonal rental occupancy at up to 5%, but no county local law, registration or return pages were found. Other county-level business duties were not checked.

items.title: Register for the Westchester County occupancy tax
items.authority: Westchester County Department of Finance, Room Occupancy Tax division
items.description: Hotel and room operators register under Chapter 285 of the county code, submitting an Application for Certificate of Authority and an online-filing verification form to the Department of Finance. The county then issues the Certificate of Authority that allows the operator to collect the 3% room occupancy tax from guests.
items.deadline: Within three days of opening or starting a hotel or room occupancy business

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Westchester County occupancy tax return
items.authority: Westchester County Department of Finance, Room Occupancy Tax division
items.description: Every registered operator files a return each quarter through the county's online system and remits the 3% tax collected, even when there were no room rentals. A return falling due on a weekend or bank holiday is due the next business day.
exemptions: Permanent residents and exempt occupants

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation Mobility Tax (MCTMT) return
items.authority: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance
items.description: Employers that must withhold New York income tax and have more than $312,500 of payroll expense in a quarter within the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District (the five New York City counties and Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk and Westchester) file Form MTA-305 each quarter. Westchester County is in Zone 2, where the tax is 0.055% on payroll up to $375,000, 0.115% up to $437,500, 0.34% up to $2.5 million and 0.635% above. The employer pays it and may not deduct it from wages. There are no extensions.
exemptions: Employers whose payroll expense in the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District is $312,500 or less in the quarter
Federal agencies, the United Nations and similar exempt employers
Local government employers (not subject to the tax in Zone 2)

appliesWhen.description: Payroll above $312,500 in a quarter (about $1.25 million a year)

items.title: Obtain a Westchester County home improvement license
items.authority: Westchester County Department of Consumer Protection, Licensing Division
items.description: Home improvement contractors need a county license, applied for with a notarized application sent to the Licensing Division in White Plains and requiring proof of insurance and workers' compensation coverage. Since January 1, 2026 the fee is $750 for a two-year license ($100 more for optional expedited review); a renewal received after expiry adds a $50 late fee and is not accepted after 60 days, and vehicle decals cost $10 each. Processing takes about 60 business days.

appliesWhen.description: Does home improvement work on residential property

items.title: Register for the Wyoming County occupancy tax
items.description: Operators complete the county's Registration and Application for Certificate of Authority to Collect Guest Room Occupancy Tax, giving business details, room count, business type and ownership, and send it to the Treasurer's Office in Warsaw. The rate and return dates were not found on the page read.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Yates County occupancy tax
items.description: Operators file a Certification of Registration with the Department of Finance, which issues a Certificate of Authority for each location within ten days. VRBO collects and remits the tax on its bookings; Airbnb does not, so the owner is responsible for Airbnb bookings.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Yates County occupancy tax return
items.description: A quarterly return is required even when no tax is due; the periods end February 28, May 31, August 31 and November 30 and the returns are due March 20, June 20, September 20 and December 20. The tax is 4% of rent, with a 5% penalty the day after the due date and interest after 30 days. The 5% administrative credit ends with the third quarter of 2026.
exemptions: Permanent residents
Certain exempt organizations

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental
